content.text: Beyond The Game is a movement that encourages sports enthusiasts to stay active while creating measurable social impact — where every run, match, or game is converted into impact aligned with SROI and SDGs.

Beyond The Game — UX Case Highlight

One challenge I often see in impact-driven products is this: people are willing to contribute, but the impact feels abstract and hard to measure.

In Beyond The Game, the challenge was to design an experience that helps sports enthusiasts understand how everyday activities can translate into real, measurable social impact, without disrupting their existing routines.

UX approach & key decisions:

  • - Designed an activity-to-impact conversion that turns sports participation into measurable outcomes
  • - Visualized impact through SROI and SDGs alignment, making contributions tangible and credible
  • - Reduced friction by allowing users to create impact simply by doing what they already love: staying active
  • - Focused on clarity and motivation to encourage long-term engagement beyond one-off events

Outcome:

A product experience that connects movement with purpose — making social impact visible, trusted, and measurable.
